name: mapping_capture
description: Deep mapping path: drive the REAL capture screen under the synthetic camera. openCapture navigates to /capture — the app runs its OWN start_mapping, and the synthetic scene feeds the real detector + decoder — then awaitDecode asserts that all LED ids were actually recovered end to end through the app (not the start/stop-mapping RPC, and not a unit test). The final VIO solve is exercised by finishCapture, but the default journey stops at decode: the visual-inertial solver needs real inertial data the headless synthetic scene doesn't yet synthesize (follow-up — see README). Needs a connected device.

steps.description: navigate to the capture screen; it auto-starts the synthetic capture + mapping
wait until the real decoder recovers every LED id from the synthetic scene
